artworks.title: William Leybourn, Mathematician
artworks.description: The image features a portrait focused on the upper body of a man. He is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the left. The man has medium-length curly hair, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, large eyes, a straight nose, and a subtly downturned mouth with a small mustache. He is wearing a dark coat with a large, turned-up white collar adorned with tassel-like decorative elements. The background has an engraved texture depicting clouds in the sky and rocky formations on the right side.

artworks.title: Nicholas Claude Fabri de Peireso, French Antiquary
artworks.description: The image is a black and white portrait of a man showing his upper body, including his head, shoulders, and part of his chest. The man is positioned slightly turned to his right, facing the viewer. He has a beard and mustache, with hair that is combed back and appears wavy. The expression on his face is neutral. He is wearing clothing typical of the era, consisting of a loose-fitting garment with a large, plain white collar. There are no visible objects or jewelry on his person. The background of the portrait features a simple lined texture. At the bottom of the portrait, there is text that reads, "NICOLAVS CLAVDIVS FABRICIVS DE PEIRESO SENATOR AQVENSIS" and a smaller inscription, "R. Gaywood fecit Lond 1656."

artworks.title: John Playford, Musician and Music Publisher
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing from the waist up, looking at the viewer. He has long wavy hair, a mustache, and is wearing period clothing with a prominent collar. He is holding a book with music notation and the text "Non nobis Domine" in his right hand. The background features a woven pattern surrounding him and two cherubs at the top holding a musical score with the words "Cantate Domino Canticum nov." There is an engraving below him with text, his age "Ætatis Sue 40," and the year "An: Dom: 1665."

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view of Mary Stuart, Queen of Scotland. She is standing upright, facing forward with her arms crossed in front of her, clasping a crucifix against her chest. Her expression is calm, and her eyes are directed towards the viewer. She has distinctive facial features with arched eyebrows and a small, slightly upturned mouth. Her hair is styled beneath a decorative cap, topped with a crown that signifies her royal status. She is dressed in a dark, voluminous gown with elaborate lace ruffles around her neck, and a large cloak drapes over her shoulders. A chain with a cross is visible around her neck. The background is plain with horizontal lines, and the text "Mary Stuart Queen of Scotland" is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Cuthbert Sydenham
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long, oval-shaped face looking at the viewer. He is holding a closed book in front of his torso. He has wavy hair and is dressed in a dark coat with a white collar and a visible vest or shirt underneath. The background consists of vertical lines. There are inscriptions below the portrait.

artworks.title: Lady Eleanor Temple, Wife of Sir Peter Templeof Stanton Bury
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman visible from the waist up. She faces forward with a serene expression, has long curly hair, and wears an elegant draped garment. She is adorned with a beaded necklace, a strand of pearls in her hair, and a decorative brooch. The portrait includes an inscription identifying her as "The Lady Eli Temple" and contains additional text praising her. A textured background with a coat of arms in the upper left corner complements the formal and historical nature of the portrait.

artworks.title: Barbara Van Beck, the Bearded Lady
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up in a standing position. The individual has a long beard, a high forehead, and hair pulled back. They are wearing elaborate clothing with voluminous sleeves. The person's head is slightly turned, one hand rests on nearby pipes, and the other hand is by their side. The background features a crosshatched pattern. Textual descriptions are visible in the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: John Trapp, Vicar of Weston-on-Avon, BiblicalCommentator
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man seated at a table. He is facing slightly left and has one hand on an open book and the other hand holding a pen. The man has a mustache, a small goatee, and short hair under a cap. He is wearing a buttoned tunic with a large white collar and white cuffs. The background has an oval pattern. There is a poem or text, a signature, and the engraving date of 1654 at the bottom of the engraving.

artworks.title: Henry Somerset, Earl of Worcester, First Dukeof Beaufort
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of an individual. The person is facing forward with a slight turn to the left side, looking directly at the viewer. He has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and a slight goatee. The person is dressed in formal attire with a lace collar, a dark garment, and material over his shoulders. The background is plain with light lines, enclosed in an oval frame, and the name "Henery Somerset Earle of Worcester etc." is inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Illustration for Edward Benlowes, Theophila
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring an angelic figure guiding an eagle upwards. The drawing includes a detailed depiction of a room with an arched doorway on the left. An angelic figure with wings is pointing upwards, guiding an eagle with its hand. The eagle is perched beside a globe-like object on a table adorned with bulbous supports. Celestial elements like stars and a radiant architectural form reminiscent of a heavenly dome occupy the sky above the angel, accompanied by winged cherubs. The lower part of the drawing contains ornate, handwritten calligraphy that describes the scene. The neoclassical style of this work, coupled with intricate hatching and line work, suggests an influence from engravings of European origin.

artworks.title: Illustration for Edward Benlowes, Theophila
artworks.description: This is an image of a scene featuring a writer and a crowned figure. The composition includes a seated figure in elaborate attire, seated beneath an archway. Above, a figure with wings appears to be offering a crown to the seated figure. The writer, seated opposite, appears to be focused on their work. The setting includes classical architectural elements. In the foreground, there is elegant script introducing a passage. The detailed line work and shading suggest a traditional engraving style.

artworks.title: Illustration for Sir William Denny, Peliconicidium
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dramatic landscape. The drawing depicts a scene where two figures, clothed in historical garments with wide-brimmed hats, stand amidst a landscape filled with hints of adventure and exploration. Rays of light emanate from above, suggesting a heavenly or divine scene, with a city or castle appearing to float in the clouds in the distance. The figures gaze and point towards this ethereal structure, with one holding a staff and the other a sword. At their feet, a cloudy mist swirls around rough terrain. The background and details are intricately etched, providing depth and contrast to this visionary landscape. Text in cursive handwriting fills the bottom of the page. "Etched by Barlow" is noted as the artist.

artworks.title: William Dobson, Portrait Painter
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man, focusing on the head and upper torso. The person is positioned in a slight three-quarter view, looking towards the viewer. He has long, wavy hair that falls around his shoulders and a distinctive mustache. His facial features are defined, with prominent cheekbones and a slightly furrowed brow. He is wearing a jacket over a shirt with a wide collar or scarf, which gives an impression of a voluminous neckline. The background features a textured oval border within a rectangular frame. The overall engraving style is detailed with hatching to suggest shadow and depth.

artworks.title: William Dobson, Portrait Painter
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up, captured in a three-quarter view. He has distinct facial features with a prominent mustache and an oval face. His hair is full, wavy, and long, cascading down to his shoulders. The man is dressed in a dark jacket or coat over a white shirt. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background features an oval frame within the artwork set against a textured, intricately-hatched pattern. An inscription at the bottom of the image identifies the person as Gulielmi Dobson.

artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in ornate armor, with long wavy hair, a distinctive mustache, and a refined look. He is looking slightly to the left, positioned in a three-quarter view. The person is wearing a chain with a large medallion around the neck, indicating status. The background features a simple fabric drapery and the portrait is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in an oval frame. The individual faces forward with large eyes, a slender nose, and full lips in a neutral expression. They have long, wavy hair, a detailed collar on a formal outfit, intricate sleeves, a veil, and delicate earrings. The background is composed of fine lines within the oval frame, setting the stage for the head and upper body in a classic portrait style.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with prominent facial features, wearing a high-collared garment with decorative elements and a bow at the neck. They have curls framing their face, partially covered by a head covering or veil. The individual is positioned against a textured oval frame background. Below the portrait is an ornate coat of arms featuring a crest with a motto on a ribbon stating "DIEU ET MON DROIT," held by two animals.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is seated, facing slightly to his left, with his right shoulder forward. His facial features include a long face with high cheekbones, a prominent nose, almond-shaped eyes, and a small mustache. His long, curly hair drapes over his shoulders. He wears a detailed, period-style outfit with a jacket, broad collar with lace detail, and draped outer garment. The background features an oval frame with inscribed text around the portrait and handwritten text below it. The overall style of the engraving is classic and ornate.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: This image depicts a portrait of a man. The man is turned slightly to his right, capturing a three-quarter view of his face. He has long, dark, and wavy hair, a mustache, and defined eyebrows. He is wearing an outfit with a white collar and a dark cloak. The portrait is enclosed within a circular border with an inscription. The background consists of fine lines radiating outwards. Below the image is a panel identifying the person as Charles II, King of Great Britain, France, and Ireland.

artworks.title: Mary, Princess of Orange
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, turned slightly to her right but facing the viewer directly. She has an oval face, large eyes, a small mouth, and curly hair falling past her shoulders with a string of beads. She wears a luxurious garment with a low neckline held together by a brooch, accessorized with a string of pearls around her neck and a ring on her finger. The background features a detailed oval frame.

artworks.title: Mary, Princess of Orange
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body, from the chest up. She is slightly turned to her left, looking directly at the viewer. She has a youthful face, large eyes, curly hair falling around her shoulders, and is wearing an off-the-shoulder gown with elaborate fabric. She wears a pearl necklace and a decorative brooch. The background consists of an intricately engraved oval frame with a textured pattern. An inscription at the bottom identifies her as a princess.

artworks.title: Prince Rupert, K.G.
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing to the right. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose, full lips, and large eyes. His long, wavy hair falls past his shoulders. The man is wearing historical armor with a patterned collar. He holds an object in his left hand. The background has a lined pattern forming an oval frame around him. Ornate text at the bottom describes his titles and lineage.

artworks.title: Sir Edmund Anderson, Knt.
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly left, with his gaze towards the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, a beard, and short hair under a cap. He wears a textured garment with a wide ruff collar. He holds a scroll in his left hand. The background has a detailed circular frame with inscriptions, and below is a coat of arms in a shield. The image suggests a formal and dignified subject of historical importance.

artworks.title: William Bates, D.D.
artworks.description: The image is an upper-body portrait of a man with long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He has a solemn expression and is wearing a traditional clerical collar and a long robe with draped fabric. A small portion of a white collar is visible around his neck. The portrait is framed with intricate oval designs on a plain background. Inscribed below the portrait is "Gulielmus Bateius, S.S Theologia Professor."
